versions.content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00238 If the provide activating event feature is enabled, the RTE generator in contract phase shall generate the type Rte_ActivatingEvent_<name> (activation vector) , where <name> is the symbol describing the runnable entity’s entry point, to store the activation bits. Based on the highest value of ExecutableEntityActi- vationReason . bitPosition for this runnable entity the type shall be either uint8 , uint16 , or uint32 so that the highest value of bitPosition fits into the data type.
